items.title: 'Oh my word!' - Netherlands' Visser wins 100m hurdles by one thousandth of a second
items.summary: Netherlands Nadine Visser pips Poland's Pia Skrzyszowska to the women's 100m hurdles gold medal by a thousandth of a second at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.
